ወሰምሶንሰ: ሰምሶን — and as for Samson (ወ- + proper name + emphatic -ሰ)
እም፲ወ፪: እም — from twelve, one of the twelve (እም- 'from' + numeral ፲ወ፪, spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ (ʿäśärtu wä-kəlʾetu) 'twelve')
እምያዕቆብ: ያዕቆብ — from Jacob, by Jacob (እም- 'from' + proper name; of the father of a child)
ውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — as for him (3ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
አስተርአያ: አስተርአየ — he appeared to her (3ms perfect, ʾastä-stem of ርእየ 'see', 'show oneself' + -ኣ '3fs to her', written -ያ)
ለእሙ: እም — to his mother (ለ- + noun 'mother' + -ሁ '3ms his', giving እሙ)
ለሰምሶን: ሰምሶን — to Samson, Samson's (ለ- + proper name; marks the possessor in apposition to ለእሙ)
ተዐቀቢ: ተዐቀበ — guard yourself, beware (2fs imperative, tä-stem of ዐቀበ 'keep')
ወኢትቅረቢ: ቀርበ — and do not approach (ወ- + ኢ- + 2fs jussive, G, q-r-b)
ናዝራዊ: ናዝራዊ — Nazirite, one consecrated by vow (noun; Numbers 6)
ቅዱሱ: ቅዱስ — his holy one (adjective used as noun + -ሁ '3ms his', giving ቅዱሱ; the suffix anticipates ለእግዚኣብሔር, 'God's holy one')
ኢታዕርጊ: አዕረገ — do not lay on, do not put up (ኢ- + 2fs jussive, causative of ዐርገ 'go up')
ወኢይብላዕ: በልዐ — and let him not eat (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, G, b-l-ʿ)
ወኢወይነ: ወይን — and not wine (ወ- + ኢ- + noun ወይን 'wine', accusative ወይነ)
ወኢያውስብ: አውሰበ — and let him not marry (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
ፈጥረት: ፍጥረት — creation, creature (noun; written ፈጥረት here); said here of a people or race (?)
እምዘመዲ: ዘመድ — from kin, from the kindred of (እም- 'from' + noun 'kin, relative'; the ending -ዲ is unexplained, since 1cs 'my' would be -የ, so 'my kin' is doubtful) (?)
መሳፍንት: መስፍን — judges, rulers (noun, plural መሳፍንት; መጽሐፈ መሳፍንት 'the Book of Judges')
ወተዐደወ: ተዐደወ — and he transgressed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ዐደወ 'cross over'; with an accusative, 'break a command')
ወመጠዎ: መጠወ — and he delivered him, handed him over (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ '3ms him')
ወአዖርዎ: አዖረ — and they blinded him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ዐወረ 'be blind' + -ኦ '3ms him')
ወረሰይዎ: ረሰየ — and they made him, set him (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ኦ '3ms him'; takes a predicate accusative 'as, to be')
መስተዛውዐ: መስተዛውዕ — one who sports, a jester (m- agent noun of ተዛወዐ, a tä-stem of the fāʿälä type; accusative) (?)
በው: ውስተ — first part of a split word: በው + ስተ = በውስተ 'in' (see በውስተ); not a word by itself
ስተ: ውስተ — second part of a split word: በው + ስተ = በውስተ 'in' (see በውስተ); not a word by itself
ወአፍረሰ: አፍረሰ — and he pulled down, demolished (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ፈረሰ 'fall, collapse')
መልዕልቶሙ: መልዕልት — their upper part, summit (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; here the roof or upper floor) (?)
፸፼: ፸፼ — 700,000, spoken ሰብዓ ትእልፊት (säbʿa təʾəlfit) 'seventy ten-thousands, seven hundred thousand' (numeral; ፼ = 10,000)
ወበሕይወቱሰ: ሕይወት — and in his life (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his' + emphatic -ሰ)
ወ፪፼: ፪፼ — and 20,000, spoken ወክልኤቱ ትእልፊት (wä-kəlʾetu təʾəlfit) 'and two ten-thousands, and twenty thousand' (ወ- 'and' between numerals; ፼ = 10,000) (?)
ወበበትር: በትር — and with a staff (ወ- + በ- 'with' + noun)
ወበመንከሰ: መንከስ — and with the jawbone of (ወ- + በ- 'with' + noun, construct 'jawbone of') (?)
ብዝኆሙ: ብዝኅ — their multitude, their great number (noun + -ሙ '3mp their')
አኅደጎሙ: አኅደገ — he released them, made them leave (3ms perfect, causative of ኀደገ 'leave' + -ሙ '3mp them')
እምሳምሶን: ሳምሶን — from Samson, by Samson (እም- + proper name)
ኀያል: ኀያል — strong, mighty (adjective; also 'a mighty one', noun)
ወደሊላሰ: ደሊላ — and as for Delilah (ወ- + proper name + emphatic -ሰ)
ለመክሳባ: መክሳባ — Meksaba's, of Meksaba (ለ- + proper name; marks the possessor) · ለ- marking the object, doubling -ኣ on the verb (አክበርዋ ... ለመክሳባ 'honored her, Meksaba')
ሰምሶን: ሰምሶን — Samson (proper name; variant spelling of ሳምሶን)
መክሳባ: መክሳባ — Meksaba (proper name; the Philistine queen in this tradition)
ወአልቦን: አልቦ — and they have not, there is not to them (ወ- + አልቦ + -ን '3fp them')
ፅኑሳት: ፅኑስ — pregnant (adjective, fem. plural; of ፀንሰ 'conceive') (?)
ስድስቱ: ስድስቱ — six (numeral, masculine; written as a word)
ቈላሶን: ቈላሶን — Qolason (proper name; the Philistine king in this tradition)
ወሞቱ: ሞተ — and they died (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, m-w-t)
ወይትፋቀራ: ተፋቀረ — and they loved one another (ወ- + 3fp imperfect, reciprocal tä-stem; Geʿez has no dual, the ending marks two women)
ወፍቅሮንሂ: ፍቅር — and their love also (ወ- + noun ፍቅር 'love' + -ሆን '3fp their' contracted to -ን + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
ለሕፃና: ሕፃን — to her child (ለ- + noun + -ሃ '3fs her', written -ና after the consonant, as in እኅታ)
ፍ: ፍቅር — first part of a split word: ፍ + ቅሮን = ፍቅሮን 'their love' (see ወፍቅሮንሂ); not a word by itself
ቅሮን: ፍቅር — second part of a split word: ፍ + ቅሮን = ፍቅሮን 'their love' (see ወፍቅሮንሂ); not a word by itself
ወነበራ: ነበረ — and they lived, dwelt (ወ- + 3fp perfect, G, n-b-r; of two women)
እምቀትለ: ቀትል — from the slaughter of (እም- + verbal noun ቀትል 'killing', construct)
ዘተርፈ: ተረፈ — who remained (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G, t-r-f)
ነግሠት: ነግሠ — she reigned (3fs perfect, G, n-g-s)
ወሰርከ: ሰርክ — and evening (ወ- + noun, accusative used adverbially)
ዘእንበሌኪ: ዘእንበለ — apart from you, besides you (preposition, stem ዘእንበሌ- + -ኪ '2fs you')
እምከርሥኪ: ከርሥ — from your womb (እም- 'from' + noun 'belly, womb' + -ኪ '2fs your')
ለአምላክነ: አምላክ — our god (ለ- marking the object + noun + -ነ '1cp our')
ወዘይነግሥ: ነግሠ — and who will reign (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
ናነግሣ: አነገሠ — we shall make her king, make her queen (1cp imperfect, causative of ነግሠ + -ኣ '3fs her')
ወስመ: ስም — and the name of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወሐለዩ: ሐለየ — and they sang, chanted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-l-y; the verb's basic sense is 'think, meditate') (?)
ወቤል: ቤል — and Bel (ወ- + proper name; a god)
አክበርዋ: አክበረ — they honored her (3mp perfect, causative of ከበረ + -ኣ '3fs her', written -ዋ after -ዉ)
ወተረክበ: ተረክበ — and was found (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ረከበ 'find')
ወደሊላኒ: ደሊላ — and Delilah also (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
ወሐፀናሆሙ: ሐፀነ — and they nursed them (ወ- + 3fp perfect ሐፀና, G, ḥ-ṣ-n + -ሆሙ '3mp them'; the two women)
በቅድሜሆን: ቅድም — before them (በ- + ቅድሜ- + -ሆን '3fp them'; of the women)
ዘዲባጋት: ዲባጋት — of brocades (ዘ- 'of' + plural noun, perhaps from Persian dībā 'silk brocade') (?)
ሐቌያቲሆሙ: ሐቌ — their hips (noun, plural ሐቌያት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
ወአዕ: አዕኑግ — first part of a split word: ወአዕ + ኑገ = ወአዕኑገ 'and collars' (?); not a word by itself
ኑገ: አዕኑግ — second part of a split word: ወአዕ + ኑገ = ወአዕኑገ 'and collars' (?); not a word by itself

__broaden__.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
__broaden__.፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine) · spoken ኀምስ (ḫaməs) before a feminine noun (፭ ዓመተ 'five years')
__broaden__.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ) · 'if it is' after እመ, the subject the unborn child (ወእመሂ ኮነት ወለተ 'and if it is a daughter')
__broaden__.ለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — of/for the king of (ለ- + construct) · ለ- marking the object, doubling -ኦ on the verb (ቀተሎ ... ለንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'he killed him, the king of the Philistines')
